title: Triplelift bidder params (Prebid Server)
description: A schema which validates params accepted by the Triplelift adapter

inventoryCode.description: TripleLift inventory code for this ad unit (provided to you by your partner manager)

parentId.description: Optional TripleLift parent ID identifier, forwarded as imp.ext.parentId

publisherId.description: Optional TripleLift publisher ID identifier, forwarded as imp.ext.publisherId
